Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: send a step-by-step guide for how to register out to the students earlier, so that one doesn't have to stress about if it will work out

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: sign in on UNIMIA, go to the section course registration, click on the uppermost button on each page until you get to a table, where you type in the courses you want to take, click save.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: none was actively offered, as it is not really necessary. I guess you can write an email to mobility office and ask for help if it would be needed

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: great succes

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: pick interesting courses
